maya: Heads up — we had 3 OOMs on prod gpu-pool-4 between 02:13-02:20 UTC, all correlated to very long contexts (~80k-120k tokens) hitting the KV cache. Logs attached in the perf link. :eyes:
cheng: :eyes: can you paste the small repro or perf snippet? any common kernel switch events?
alex: saw the same alerts, stack traces point at `kv_slab_alloc` failing after a kernel-selection spike (we rolled a kernel tweak yesterday).
maya: repro snippet: `session_id=abc123, ctx_len=98_400, alloc_try=3, evict_candidate=0`
maya: perf link: https://perf.redwood/internal/runs/2026-03-18/kv-oom-abc123
cheng: quick grep from the perf dump:
```
kv_slab_total=11.9GB
kv_fragmented=3.2GB
kv_reserved_for_kernels=2.4GB  # noticeable bump after kernel-switch
kv_active=6.3GB
```
cheng: shows fragmentation + a reserve increase exactly at kernel switch timestamp.
sandeep: batching heuristic change increased average batch token length -> more KV entries live longer which increased fragmentation. we should consider reverting or adding an aggressive compaction trigger.
alex: short mitigations we can ship now: 1) lower `kvcache.max_prefix_bytes` from 32MB -> 8MB 2) enable `kvcache.early_eviction=true` 3) revert kernel-selection affinity for longctx for canary pool.
maya: +1 for config changes as hotfix. can we also add a graceful degrade path to drop KV caching above 60k tokens? app-side fallback?
cheng: implementation note: dropping KV cache path requires a warm-start penalty — but it's safe as a circuit breaker. flag: `kvcache.disable_if_ctx_gt=60000`
alex: I'll prepare the rollback PR for kernel selection and a hotfix with the two config toggles. tagging @oncall-bot to run canary smoke.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0318-47 — oncall page pinged. Steps: run canary with hotfix, monitor OOM rate and tail latency.
sandeep: for medium-term: add compact-on-idle pass (background compaction after N ops) + a fragmentation metric to alert before OOM. also add KV spill-to-disk prototype for >128k contexts.
maya: agree. also add a perf test with synthetic long-dialog sequences (50k, 80k, 120k) in CI to prevent regressions.
cheng: I'll add telemetry: track `kv_fragmentation_ratio` and `kernel_reserve_delta` per deploy. set alert at fragmentation_ratio>0.25.
alex: PRs: rollback kernel-selection (DRAFT) -> https://phab.redwood/D12345; hotfix config -> https://phab.redwood/D12346. planning canary roll at 02:40 UTC.
maya: thanks, team. please post quick postmortem once we have data. :thumbsup:
